screen.subtitle: Choose how many times a day the app asks whether you've smoked.

countCard.title: Notifications per day
countCard.infoText: We'll ask you up to {{count}} times a day if you've smoked.

distributionCard.title: Automatic distribution
distributionCard.sub: Notifications will be spread out automatically and evenly throughout the day.
distributionCard.previewSub: The times adjust automatically to your settings.

tips.1: One notification a day is enough to start tracking.
tips.2: Morning and evening: the minimum for effective tracking.
tips.3: 3 reminders a day for balanced tracking.
tips.4: 4 reminders: ideal for the first few weeks.
tips.5: 5 reminders keep you aware of your consumption throughout the day.
tips.6: 6 notifications a day is ideal to stay motivated without being disturbed.

alerts.permissionDeniedBody: Enable notifications in iOS Settings to receive reminders.
alerts.disableConfirmBody: You'll no longer receive reminders to log your cigarettes.
